gztell.reason: gztell returns an integer offset value, not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it simply queries the current position of an existing gzFile handle.

gzprintf.reason: gzprintf returns an int (the number of bytes written or an error code), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it merely uses the existing gzFile handle.

adler32_combine.reason: The function returns a plain integer value (uLong), not a pointer, so ownership and lifecycle questions do not apply.

gzeof.reason: gzeof returns an int (not a pointer), merely querying the EOF state of an existing gzFile handle without allocating or freeing any memory.

inflateInit_.reason: inflateInit_ initialises the z_stream state (allocating internal structures into strm->state) but returns an int status code, not a pointer, so ownership of a returned pointer does not apply; the caller owns the strm it passes in and must later call inflateEnd to free internal state.

crc32_combine_gen.reason: The function returns a uLong value (not a pointer), so ownership and lifecycle concepts do not apply.

adler32_z.reason: The function returns a plain integer (uLong checksum), not a pointer, so ownership and lifecycle questions do not apply, and it is safe to expose directly.

get_crc_table.reason: The function returns a pointer to a static internal table (crc_table) owned by the library; the caller must not free it.

adler32.reason: adler32 returns a plain integer checksum value, not a pointer, so ownership and lifecycle do not apply.

deflate.reason: deflate returns an int status code, not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it operates on a caller-managed z_streamp without transferring ownership of any memory.
